mainEntity.name: How do you measure the success of GEO for Service Pages optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Measuring success involves tracking key performance indicators such as local search rankings for targeted keywords, organic traffic to location-specific service pages, and lead generation from those pages. We also monitor conversion rates, calls directly from local search results, and form submissions. Tools like Google Analytics and Google Search Console provide valuable data on page performance, user behavior, and geographic reach. Regular reporting helps us assess the effectiveness of the strategy and make informed adjustments to continuously improve results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Success is measured by tracking local search rankings, organic traffic to service pages, lead generation, and conversion rates. We use tools like Google Analytics for performance data.
